```{python}

#import modules
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd 
```

```{python}
#duplicate standard deviations 

#read in data 
dups = pd.read_csv(r"C:\Users\rc_local\Documents\A16S O2\dup_stdevs.csv")

#calculate mean stdev
avg_stdev = np.mean(dups['dup stdev'])

#calculate median
med_stdev = np.median(dups['dup stdev'])

#calculate IQR
q3, q1 = np.percentile(dups['dup stdev'], [75, 25])
iqr = q3 - q1

#plot histogram
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.hist(dups['dup stdev'], color='royalblue', edgecolor='black', bins=np.arange(0, 5, 0.1))
ax.axvline(avg_stdev, color = 'red')
ax.set_xlabel('Standard Deviation')
ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax.set_title('A16S 2026 O2 Duplicate Standard Deviation');
```
